# Caddy reverse proxy

The swarm's Caddy (stack `caddy`, production and the local `*.lvh.me` devel
variant) is configured and deployed only from the **league-network** repo,
`services/caddy-proxy/`. The old `caddy-proxy` repo/submodule and
`docker/caddy-proxy-devel` here are retired.
